3D MahJongg.name: 3D MahJongg
3D MahJongg.summary: The first MahJongg game in the eShop – which is designed specifically for your Nintendo 3DS!

Amazing Spider-Man 2, The.name: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
Amazing Spider-Man 2, The.summary:
The Nintendo DS port of The Amazing Spider-Man 2, a video game based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man and the 2014 film of the same name.

Two years after the death of Ben Parker, Peter Parker his nephew gains special spider-like powers to become Spider-man. But now with the rise of enemies like Harry Osborn, kingpin, And the Russian Mob, Spider-man is in one of his biggest battles yet. However, he is not the only one hunting villains.

Disney Magical World 2.name: Disney Magical World 2
Disney Magical World 2.summary:
Live your dream life in Disney Magical World 2 alongside fan-favorite Disney characters! Adventure with Elsa and Olaf from Disney Frozen, dance with Disney Princesses, soar with Mickey in Magical Dream parades, and more, while snapping photos to share your memories. The magic is in your hands, so use your wand to solve a ghostly mystery along the way!

Explore six different Disney-themed worlds from classics like Disney Frozen, Disney The Little Mermaid, and Walt Disney Lilo & Stitch. You can harvest a field with Winnie the Pooh, fish with Donald Duck, mine with the Seven Dwarves, explore ghost-filled dungeons for treasures, and more! On your journey, youll discover the magical town of Castleton, where youll live amongst classic Disney characters. Shop with Daisy, Minnie, and others to build and buy hundreds of Disney-themed items. You can customize amazing outfits and even decorate your dream home and Cafe. Ready to make a memory? Then dance at the Enchanted Ball or throw a Cafe Party with your new Disney friends!

DualPenSports.name: DualPenSports
DualPenSports.summary: The game gets its name from the fact that two special sports styluses are used to play the game. The sports are soccer, baseball, boxing, basketball, paragliding, archery and skiing. There are also tap exercises to help players get used to playing the game with two styluses rather than one.

Fire Emblem - Kakusei.name: Fire Emblem Awakening
Fire Emblem - Kakusei.summary:
Armies clash as the world burns. As an inevitable war draws ever closer, you must stand with Chrom and his forces--knights, mages, archers, and more--commanding them against the armies of kingdoms, empires, and the dead themselves.

Plan your strategery. Move your troops on the battlefield, then choose their weapon and attack. Using the new Pair Up and Dual systems, support your attacks with the help of nearby allies and watch their skills and relationships grow.

New Love Plus.name: New LovePlus+
New Love Plus.summary: New LovePlus + is an enhanced version of the 3DS Japanese exclusive "New Love Plus". Released 2 years after the original, New LovePlus + has most of the same content as the original with some new content, though certain features have been removed. The game is a dating sim developed and published by Konami for the Nintendo 3DS but it never got released outside of Japan.

Puyo Puyo!! 20th Anniversary.name: Puyo Puyo!! 20th Anniversary
Puyo Puyo!! 20th Anniversary.summary:
It is the 2nd anniversary game in the series and as such shares more similarities to "Puyo Puyo! 15th Anniversary" than "Puyo Puyo 7". This game came out 4 months before "Sonic Generations", which is also commemorating the 20th anniversary of the Sonic games.
There are 24 playable characters available, each with their own 8-stage course (similar to Puyo Puyo! 15th Anniversary).
This game, as it's predecessor, was released only in Japan.

SEGA 3D Fukkoku Archives 2.name: Sega 3D Classics Collection
SEGA 3D Fukkoku Archives 2.summary: Sega 3D Classics Collection is a Sega Genesis compilation game developed by M2 and published by Sega for the Nintendo 3DS.
